desc:
Welcome to Don’t Steal Verity!

How to Play:
• Sneak up and steal Verity while they sleep😴
• RUN when they wake up and chase you!🏃
• Take them home and collect tons of cash💸
• Upgrade your characters to earn even more🔥
• Expand your plot to unlock extra slots🏗️
• Trade & gift Verity with friends to grow together!🎁
• Complete your Index to unlock cash boosts & base colors!📖
• But be careful... a sleeping Verity can WAKE at any second!🤫

Remember, your Veritys earn cash even while you're offline!⏰
